meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. Who decided on the zero, and was anyone going to call me before it went in the gradebook?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing that down. It doesn't answer what I asked. Your own procedure says a parent is called before any mark goes in, and nobody called me.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Removing it is the minimum. I want that in writing today, and I want an apology for how Owen found out.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in the meeting to remove the zero. I still require written confirmation of that and an apology for how Owen found out. I expect the written confirmation today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, and you agreed to remove the zero with nothing in return, so she still wants it in writing today along with an apology; that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and the fair result is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her; she took your withdrawal as a win and gave nothing back.
What cost ground: You dropped the zero in the very next turn after she pressed on procedure, which abandoned the version history you had just put on the table.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM came close to that kind of night, which is why she wrote it down and went straight to procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and why nobody called, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then give the version history with its date and offer the supervised rewrite under 4.4 instead of withdrawing the zero.
